definitions.short: a water-ox , i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse
definitions.full: H930. Behemoth בְּהֵמוֺת noun masculine behemoth , i.e. hippopotamus (apparently plural intensive of foregoing; according to Di Job 40:15 compare De Isa 30:6 from an (assumed) Egyptain p-ehemau, ox of the water ) Job 40:15 (on identity, compare further Bo Hieroz. iii. 705 ); probably also Psa 73:22 עִמָּ֑ךְ הָיִיתִי בְּהֵמוֺת a behemoth was I with ( toward ) thee (so Hi De; Che beasts ); according to De Or also in בַּהֲמוֺת Isa 30:6 the burden of the behemoth of the south (supposed to be a designation of Egypt; but this unlikely, compare Che Di, read therefore) rather beasts of the south , namely of Judah. בהן (compare Arabic IV. shut, cover (see foregoing) whence also = בֹּהֶן ; as closing and covering the hand, compare Lane).
definitions.rootNote: in form a plural or 929 , but really a singular of Egyptian derivation;
